rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for needing rest or sleep.

example.english: I’m really tired after work today and want to go to bed early.
example.traditional: 我今日返工返到好攰，想早啲瞓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 faan1 dou3 hou2 gui6 soeng2 zou2 di1 fan3

rows.note: Use this more formal or written word for being in need of rest or sleep.

example.english: After working for a long time, I feel tired.
example.traditional: 長時間工作後，我會感到疲倦。
example.jyutping: coeng4 si4 gaan1 gung1 zok3 hau6 ngo5 wui5 gam2 dou3 pei4 gyun6

rows.note: Use this when you feel fed up, annoyed, or sick of something rather than physically tired.

example.english: I’m already tired of this job.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 jim3 zo2 ni1 fan6 gung1
